business_overview.one_sentence: The Group trades construction materials, mainly pipes and fittings, with most revenue from Hong Kong customers.

segments.name: Trading of construction materials, mainly pipes and fittings
segments.business_substance: single operating segment assessed by executive directors

business_overview.revenue_model: Wholesale and retail sale of pipes and fittings; wholesale revenue is recognised when products are delivered and customer acceptance conditions are met, retail revenue is recognised when products are sold and delivered in store.
business_notes: Revenue by geography: Hong Kong HK$601.360m, Macau HK$30.770m, Chinese Mainland HK$13.244m.
Contract liabilities are receipts in advance from customers before product delivery.
The Group leases offices, warehouses, retail shops and staff quarters.
